text:
maria.product: Quick sync — we need a final decision on the compliance pilot scope for next quarter. Main axes: SOC2/ISO mapping, retention windows, BYOK/KMS onboarding SLOs. @samir can you share a short cost + timeline estimate?

samir.eng: Yep. I have a compact SLO matrix and cost delta per 100k active users. Will paste summary below.

maria.product: :thumbsup: Please include recovery scenarios and legal-hold overrides in that matrix.

devon.security: From security: baseline for SOC2 we expect immutable audit streams for 1y, enterprise customers often require 3y. KMS integration must support key rotation without re-encrypting customer blobs. Also need an attestation step for escrow workflows.

kevin.ops: Ops notes: BYOK onboarding effort ~2w eng + 3 CS touchpoints for pilot customers. Storage + API ops expected +12% cost for 3y retention vs 90d. For pilot we can offer a "fast-path" BYOK with 90-day retention to cut time-to-pilot.

lina.product: Proposed MVP scopes (pick one):
- Option A: BYOK handshake + 90d retention + SOC2 mapping (limit: no long-term legal-hold support initially).
- Option B: Full 1y immutable logs + KMS escrow and rotation attestations (longer build; covers finserv needs).
I lean A for pilot so we can validate UX + ops.

maria.product: Vote check — A or B? I'll collect live votes and escalate disagreements to legal. Deadline EOD.

samir.eng: A — we can ship A in ~3 sprints and add guardrails to avoid regressions.

devon.security: B from security perspective — full 1y gives stronger audit posture for banks. That said, ok to start with A if legal signs the risk acceptance for pilot customers.

kevin.ops: Also request: add a per-tenant retention TTL feature flag so we can migrate customers gradually and toggle retention without deploys. That reduces rollback risk.

maria.product: Good call. @kevin can you spec the flag + rollback plan and add a short PR checklist entry? Something like:
```
PR checklist: 
- retention_ttl: default 90d
- keystore_policy: BYOK|RedwoodManaged
- legal_hold_override: bool
- migration_plan: doc link
```

kevin.ops: Will do. I'll post the spec + rough runbook by EOD.

ops-bot: Deployment window note — staging rollout scheduled for 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC if pilots go green.

maria.product: Thanks all. Next steps: Samir -> share SLO/cost matrix (tomorrow AM). Kevin -> spec TTL flag + runbook (EOD). Lina -> draft pilot customer comms and acceptance form. Devon -> legal/attestation redlines. We'll reconvene Thurs 10:30.
